note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: The 1962 typical edition prints the single-l spelling solemnitáte; the witness has the dictionary spelling. Same word, same form.
The typical edition's punctuation is retained. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.
The lexical accent is restored in the working text under the edition's house convention; the witness's capital typography is recorded exactly.
